comparison.objective: Feed beef into a grinder using its pusher without putting fingers into the throat.
comparison.physical_skill: Place material, grasp and use a pusher, then return the tool.
comparison.success_condition: Both cubes are processed; fingertip entry more than 3 mm below the rim latches zero.
comparison.reason: Tests safe feed-tool use around machinery, not fine fastener/collar manipulation or iterative response measurement.
